from pathlib import Path


def patch_file(path_text, replacements):
    path = Path(path_text)
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for label, old, new in replacements:
        if old not in text:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{path_text} patch missing: {label}")
        text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"patched {path_text}")


patch_file("src/renderer/renderer-settings-member.js", [
    (
        "active shift choices",
        '  const visibleShifts = state.shifts.filter((shift) => !shift.hiddenFromToolbar);\n',
        '  const visibleShifts = state.shifts.filter((shift) => !shift.deleted && !shift.hiddenFromToolbar);\n'
    ),
    (
        "active members list",
        '  const sourceMembers = state.members;\n',
        '  const sourceMembers = state.members.filter((member) => !member.deleted);\n'
    ),
    (
        "active department filter",
        '            ${state.departments.map((department) => `<option value="${escapeHtml(department.id)}" ${memberSettingsFilters.department === department.id ? "selected" : ""}>${escapeHtml(department.name)}</option>`).join("")}\n',
        '            ${state.departments.filter((department) => !department.deleted).map((department) => `<option value="${escapeHtml(department.id)}" ${memberSettingsFilters.department === department.id ? "selected" : ""}>${escapeHtml(department.name)}</option>`).join("")}\n'
    )
])

patch_file("src/renderer/renderer-settings-catalog.js", [
    (
        "active catalog list",
        '  const list = getItemList(category);\n',
        '  const list = getItemList(category).filter((item) => !item.deleted);\n'
    ),
    (
        "active shift members",
        '    const members = getMembersForScheduleShift(shift.id);\n',
        '    const members = getMembersForScheduleShift(shift.id).filter((member) => !member.deleted);\n'
    ),
    (
        "active department choices",
        '        <select id="shiftApplicableDept">${buildSelectOptions(state.departments, "id", (item) => item.name, shift.applicableDeptId || "")}</select>\n',
        '        <select id="shiftApplicableDept">${buildSelectOptions(state.departments.filter((item) => !item.deleted), "id", (item) => item.name, shift.applicableDeptId || "")}</select>\n'
    ),
    (
        "validate active department",
        '  if (!state.departments.some((department) => department.id === applicableDeptId)) {\n',
        '  if (!state.departments.some((department) => department.id === applicableDeptId && !department.deleted)) {\n'
    ),
    (
        "soft delete local state",
        '''  if (category === "shift") {\n    state.shifts = state.shifts.filter((item) => item.id !== id);\n    state.members = state.members.map((member) => ({\n      ...member,\n      scheduleShiftIds: getMemberScheduleShiftIds(member).filter((shiftId) => shiftId !== id)\n    }));\n  }\n  if (category === "leave") state.leaves = state.leaves.filter((item) => item.id !== id);\n  if (category === "overtime") state.overtime = state.overtime.filter((item) => item.id !== id);\n  removeAssignmentsByItem(category, id);\n''',
        '''  if (category === "shift") {\n    state.shifts = state.shifts.map((item) => item.id === id ? { ...item, deleted: true, hiddenFromToolbar: true } : item);\n    state.members = state.members.map((member) => member.deleted ? member : ({\n      ...member,\n      scheduleShiftIds: getMemberScheduleShiftIds(member).filter((shiftId) => shiftId !== id)\n    }));\n  }\n  if (category === "leave") state.leaves = state.leaves.map((item) => item.id === id ? { ...item, deleted: true, hiddenFromToolbar: true } : item);\n  if (category === "overtime") state.overtime = state.overtime.map((item) => item.id === id ? { ...item, deleted: true, hiddenFromToolbar: true } : item);\n'''
    )
])

patch_file("src/renderer/renderer-settings-department.js", [
    (
        "active member rows",
        '  const activeMembers = state.members.filter(isMemberCurrentlyActive);\n  const departmentRows = state.departments.map((department) => {\n',
        '  const activeMembers = state.members.filter((member) => !member.deleted && isMemberCurrentlyActive(member));\n  const activeDepartments = state.departments.filter((department) => !department.deleted);\n  const departmentRows = activeDepartments.map((department) => {\n'
    ),
    (
        "active department empty state",
        '  const body = state.departments.length\n',
        '  const body = activeDepartments.length\n'
    ),
    (
        "active delete dependencies",
        '  const memberIds = state.members.filter((member) => getMemberHomeDeptId(member) === departmentId).map((member) => member.id);\n',
        '  const memberIds = state.members.filter((member) => !member.deleted && getMemberHomeDeptId(member) === departmentId).map((member) => member.id);\n'
    ),
    (
        "active shift dependencies",
        '  const usedShifts = state.shifts.filter((shift) => shift.applicableDeptId === departmentId);\n',
        '  const usedShifts = state.shifts.filter((shift) => !shift.deleted && shift.applicableDeptId === departmentId);\n'
    ),
    (
        "soft delete department local state",
        '''  state.departments = state.departments.filter((department) => department.id !== departmentId);\n  memberIds.forEach(removeScheduleByMember);\n''',
        '''  state.departments = state.departments.map((department) => department.id === departmentId\n    ? { ...department, deleted: true }\n    : department);\n'''
    ),
    (
        "no redundant save after delete",
        '  await reopenSettingsModalPreservingScroll(returnTo);\n  queueSave();\n',
        '  await reopenSettingsModalPreservingScroll(returnTo);\n'
    )
])

patch_file("tests/renderer-admin-data-contracts.test.js", [
    (
        "catalog delete soft state contract",
        '''  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(context.state.shifts, (item) => item.id), ["S2"]);\n  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(context.state.members[0].scheduleShiftIds), ["S2"]);\n  assert.equal(calls.includes("remove:shift:S1"), true);\n''',
        '''  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(context.state.shifts, (item) => item.id), ["S1", "S2"]);\n  assert.equal(context.state.shifts.find((item) => item.id === "S1")?.deleted, true);\n  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(context.state.members[0].scheduleShiftIds), ["S2"]);\n  assert.equal(calls.includes("remove:shift:S1"), false);\n'''
    )
])

patch_file("tests/settings-scroll-preservation.test.js", [
    (
        "shift delete scroll soft state contract",
        '''  assert.deepEqual(calls, ["capture", "confirm", "delete", "remove", "render", "reopen:180"]);\n  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(context.state.shifts, (item) => item.id), ["S2"]);\n  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(context.state.members[0].scheduleShiftIds), ["S2"]);\n''',
        '''  assert.deepEqual(calls, ["capture", "confirm", "delete", "render", "reopen:180"]);\n  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(context.state.shifts, (item) => item.id), ["S1", "S2"]);\n  assert.equal(context.state.shifts.find((item) => item.id === "S1")?.deleted, true);\n  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(context.state.members[0].scheduleShiftIds), ["S2"]);\n'''
    )
])
